desc:
⚽ REFEREE SIMULATOR

Become the referee and control every match!

Watch the action, spot fouls, blow your whistle and make the correct decision. Use yellow cards and red cards when needed, award free kicks and use VAR when the situation is unclear.

🏆 Build your referee career
📈 Increase your Career Overall
🌍 Progress through five leagues
📺 Review important situations with VAR
🪙 Earn coins and unlock whistles
🎁 Claim Daily Rewards
🥇 Compete on global leaderboards
Or play against other people worldwide in 1v1 mode.

Can you reach the Elite League and become the world’s best referee?

⭐ Like and favorite the game to support future updates!
